import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFile, writeFile, mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { gzipSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { build } from 'esbuild';
import { generateParser } from './generate-parser.mjs';
import { getBuildConfig, defaultOptions } from './.esbuild/util.ts';

assert.equal(process.env.MERMAID_COVERAGE, undefined, 'Coverage instrumentation is not permitted');
const source = JSON.parse(await readFile('source-receipt.json', 'utf8'));
assert.equal(source.sourceCommit, 'dcb694ddb58dc5ad3502e7e903cac05fd812eac3');
const output = resolve('artifact');
await mkdir(output, { recursive: true });
await generateParser(pathToFileURL(`${output}/`));
const config = getBuildConfig({
  ...defaultOptions, minify: true, core: false, format: 'iife', metafile: true,
  includeLargeFeatures: true, profiling: false,
  options: { name: 'mermaid', packageName: 'mermaid', file: 'mermaid.ts' },
  outdir: output,
  alias: { '@mermaid-js/parser': resolve('packages/parser/src/index.ts') },
});
const result = await build(config);
assert(result.metafile);
await writeFile(resolve(output, 'metafile.json'), `${JSON.stringify(result.metafile, null, 2)}\n`);
const bytes = await readFile(resolve(output, 'mermaid.min.js'));
// OC's canonical pako sidecar uses these parameters. Verify it separately too.
const gzipBytes = gzipSync(bytes, { level: 9, memLevel: 7 }).length;
const summary = {
  sourceCommit: source.sourceCommit,
  node: process.version,
  esbuild: JSON.parse(await readFile('node_modules/esbuild/package.json', 'utf8')).version,
  sha256: createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),
  bytes: bytes.length, gzipBytes, gzipKiB: gzipBytes / 1024, gzipBudgetBytes: 960 * 1024,
  compression: 'Node zlib level9/memLevel7; OC canonical pako3.0.2 legacyHash proof also required',
  budgetPassed: gzipBytes <= 960 * 1024,
  sourceInputs: Object.keys(result.metafile.inputs).length,
  sourceReceiptSha256: createHash('sha256').update(await readFile('source-receipt.json')).digest('hex'),
};
await writeFile(resolve(output, 'build-summary.json'), `${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`);
console.log(JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
assert(summary.budgetPassed, 'Existing OC Mermaid 960 KiB gzip budget exceeded; do not integrate or raise it');
